body: The class name need to be made explicit here, so the link works properly in the `MeshLibrary` editor.
Any reason the enum hint was removed here? Also should it still be `PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR`
The reason was me programming while feeling sleepy. :stuck_out_tongue:

```suggestion
					inspector->add_custom_property_description("MeshLibraryItem", prop.name.replace_first("item/{index}/", ""), DTR(prop.description));
```
Also using DTR here will not allow switching the language. You can assign the descriptions in `NOTIFCATION_TRANSLATION_CHANGED`, the way custom descriptions are implemented allows to swap them.

This won't work if the MeshLibrary has "holes" (just remove a mesh in the middle). You need a custom `get_property_list()` method, see how #115281 handled it.

Since meshes are no longer exposed as inspector array, there shouldn't be other problems with missing indices.

```suggestion
					inspector->add_custom_property_description("MeshLibraryItem", prop.name.replace_first("item/{index}/", ""), DTR(prop.description));
```
By "will not allow switching the language" I only meant the READY notification. DTR is still needed to use the doc Translation.
You forgot to copy this part.

```suggestion
	base_property_helper.register_property(PropertyInfo(Variant::OBJECT, PNAME("mesh"), PROPERTY_HINT_RESOURCE_TYPE, Mesh::get_class_static(), PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR), defaults.mesh, &MeshLibrary::set_item_mesh, &MeshLibrary::get_item_mesh);
```
Unless there's some reason not to? For all these (they were used in the original code)
